### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/service-i18n`, touching **22** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/services/service-i18n/README.md`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**19** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 252775d1d307df0d039f297c6c1c1822b7af5b57`.

⛔ **3** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/services/service-i18n/README.md`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **1** cross-cutting symbol(s) contributed no route anchor: `basePath (8 routes)`
- **2** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **4** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 252775d1d307df0d039f297c6c1c1822b7af5b57` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `0e803c5fd3622b5decece1367875a2d7201f02b8` — the merge of head `6dc743667cc9c518fe53a7cc73b0f71fd68b52ef` into base `252775d1d307df0d039f297c6c1c1822b7af5b57`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 0e803c5fd3622b5decece1367875a2d7201f02b8 && git checkout 0e803c5fd3622b5decece1367875a2d7201f02b8
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 252775d1d307df0d039f297c6c1c1822b7af5b57 6dc743667cc9c518fe53a7cc73b0f71fd68b52ef && git checkout -B drift-repro 252775d1d307df0d039f297c6c1c1822b7af5b57 && git merge --no-ff 6dc743667cc9c518fe53a7cc73b0f71fd68b52ef

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 252775d1d307df0d039f297c6c1c1822b7af5b57
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 252775d1d307df0d039f297c6c1c1822b7af5b57` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `6dc743667cc9c518fe53a7cc73b0f71fd68b52ef`
Local-runs: none

Inputs: card #23347 (body and all 7 comments, the two `os-dev-report` comments included), PR #23569 (body, 10-file list, net diff against `main` at the head), the 38 check-runs on the head (latest per name), and `origin/main` read through `git show` / `git grep` only. Nothing built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **`I18nServicePluginOptions` loses `registerRoutes` and `basePath`** (`packages/services/service-i18n/src/i18n-service-plugin.ts`; the type is exported from the package index). A published runtime interface narrows: breaking, declared (see ②). **Right.** Readers re-measured on `origin/main`: inside the package only (the plugin, two tests, the ledger header, the README). `serve.ts` step 3b and `plugin-dev`'s `dev-i18n.ts` construct the plugin with `defaultLocale` / `fallbackLocale` only; `content/docs` examples pass `defaultLocale` / `localesDir`; `../objectui` names neither the plugin nor the options. The dev's "none outside the package" holds.
2. **The plugin's three `kernel:ready` GET registrations are retired; it looks up no HTTP server.** On `objectstack serve` and `objectstack dev` (dispatcher composed) the wire answer on all three paths is unchanged: the dev measured before and after on the showcase (anonymous 401 in the dispatcher envelope with `X-Request-Id`; signed-in `zh` expanded to `zh-CN`, the dispatcher's `resolveLocale`), and the dispatcher's mounts at `dispatcher-plugin.ts:1480/:1489/:1498` plus the domain's anonymous floor (`domains/i18n.ts`, ADR-0056 D2) are untouched by this diff. On a composition with an HTTP server and no dispatcher the three paths go from a floor-less 200 to 404: a route-set narrowing, declared in the changeset with its remedy (compose `createDispatcherPlugin`). **Right**, and it is the retire branch of triage `6174784804` step 2, which also closes the folded class-b finding (the floor-less door) by removing the door. One route, one owner (AGENTS.md route rule 1); the class docblock forbids re-adding a mount.
3. **Negative pin** (`i18n-service-plugin.test.ts`): an HTTP server under both `http-server` and `http.server`, every hooked lifecycle event fired, nothing lands on any verb, `use` or the raw app, and the `i18n` service is still registered. Ablated red per the report. **Right.**
4. **Deleted handler-only tests** (`error-envelope.conformance.test.ts`, `i18n-routes.server-fault-withheld.test.ts`) and the #23346 `sendServerFault` arms go with the handlers they drove. The live door's 5xx posture stays the dispatcher's under the #5667 / #12509 tiering, which triage kept out of scope. **Right.** The seat tells #23174's thread, as triage step 2 directs (the dev lists it under out_of_scope_findings as noted, not filed).
5. **`i18n-route-ledger.ts` kept, re-framed as wire data; `i18n-route-ledger.conformance.test.ts` drops the two mount-vs-ledger directions and keeps row hygiene.** The rows still name routes a live composition mounts (the dispatcher's), so no row lies. **Right**, with one reading recorded: the only remaining guard holding these rows against a live mount is `packages/qa/dogfood/test/route-ledger-live-mount-parity.dogfood.test.ts`, and on this head the sharded Dogfood Regression Gate rows read `skipped` (path-filtered; the aggregate reads `success`). The dispatcher side is untouched, so the rows cannot have gone stale through this diff.
6. **`scripts/check-test-source-alias.mjs`**: the shrink-only registry entry for the package narrows to `['@objectstack/core', '@objectstack/spec']`, the gate's own prescription after the last `@objectstack/types` test importer was deleted. One line, outside the claimed surface, declared in the body and the report. **Right.**
7. **README**: the package no longer claims the routes; the REST section names the dispatcher and its floor; the options table drops two rows. **Right.** `content/docs` carries no claim that the plugin mounts these routes (grep on `origin/main`: none), so no hand-written page is falsified.
8. **Boot-log surface**: the `I18n routes registered: ...` info line and the `No HTTP server available` warning are gone. No reader outside the package (grep on `origin/main`: none). **Right.**
9. Note, not a finding: `packages/services/service-i18n/package.json` still declares `@objectstack/types` as a dependency, and after this diff no source file in the package imports it. No lint lane audits that; a follow-up tidy, in the ledger-consolidation sweep or on its own.

Check-runs on the head as read (latest per name): 25 `success` (Build Core, Check Changeset, every Lint lane including `Lint & Repo Gates`, Governed Surface Queue Guard, the claim guards, Dogfood Regression Gate aggregate, Type Check consumer / debt-ledger / source gates); 6 `skipped` (Build Docs, Console Pin Gate, the Dogfood shard rows, Dogfood Verify CLI, Packed-tarball, Temporal Conformance); 7 `in_progress` (Test Core 1/6 to 6/6, Type Check workspace). No failure. The in-progress families are recorded as read, not waited on; the queue needs them green regardless of this record.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/23347-i18n-plugin-mounts-retired.md`: `@objectstack/service-i18n: minor`, `fix(service-i18n)!:` summary, a `**BREAKING**` banner, and an `adr-0087: not-required (runtime-interface-only ...#I18nServicePluginOptions)` marker. The diff publishes exactly one package, breaking in two ways (a published options interface narrows; a dispatcher-less HTTP composition loses three routes), and under the launch-window convention (`check-changeset-no-major`) a breaking change ships `minor`. `Check Changeset` on the head: `success`. The level, the declaration carriers and the 0087 disposition match what the diff publishes. **Matches.** `skip-changeset` does not apply, as the dev reasoned.

`Clause-②:` line: the PR body carries `Clause-②: no` on its second line, copied from the claim `6180859414` as `os-dev.md:276` instructs. It is truthful (the diff widens nothing) and, with the banner and the bang, the breaking-ness is read by `check-adr-0087-registration` and `check-changeset-no-major` exactly as a declared narrowing would be. See ③ for the arm.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **open_questions 1, the direction arm.** Answered: **B**, for the claim line and the PR body. `clause2-line.mjs` defines `no (narrowing)` as the carrier for "not a widening, but breaking" (#16421, maintainer ruling option B), and the precedent the changeset itself cites, `.changeset/pre/22345-run-provenance-context-retired.md`, spells `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`. The arm is optional by the same file's text, so the bare `no` is not a defect and nothing mechanical changes. The seat amends the claim line and the PR body (seat-side edits, no new head). The changeset's own copy need not be re-pushed for this record; carry it on the next push of the branch if one happens.
- **deviations 1** (`scripts/check-test-source-alias.mjs`): accepted, see ① item 6.
- **deviations 2** (ledger kept): accepted, see ① item 5. The named carrier, a sub-issue of #23347 for the ledger consolidation and the stale-prose sweep (`serve.ts` 3b comment, `packages/client/src/index.ts` docblock, `packages/client/src/i18n-wire-dialect.test.ts:41` which still names `registerI18nRoutes`, the two route-ledger headers, `openapi-builtin-paths.ts`, `check-route-envelope.mjs` MODULES row, `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/{api-backend,i18n}.json`), is the seat's to file before merge or to carry on the card's acceptance notes. Behaviour-neutral either way.
- **deviations 3** (minor with BREAKING and bang): accepted, see ②.
- **deviations 4** (trailers): not this record's remit.
- **deviations 5** (zero label writes): right for this PR.
- **harness_parity_answer**: accepted. `bootStack` composes the dispatcher bridge and no `I18nServicePlugin`, so after this diff the dogfood `anonymous-deny-i18n` proof and `os serve` share one route owner; `packages/verify` is rightly untouched.
- **out_of_scope_findings, class a** (`objectstack serve` in production with no `OS_DATABASE_URL` registers no driver and names no remedy): a reproducible route-rule-3 defect against `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts`, outside this lane. The seat files it (Prime Directive 10); this record does not carry it.
- **Triage's "same PR" for the ADR-0076 OQ#9 line**: split into #23570 because `docs/adr/**` is Tier H and a mixed diff is governed whole (Prime Directive 14). Right; the claim authorised the split. Land #23569 first, as #23570's body says.
- **Card step 3 (the dispatcher's 5xx posture)**: untouched, as triage graded. No new gate was added.

**VERDICT: PASS**

Assignee `os-bill` = the card's. 10 files, +158/−817 (975 changed lines, under the 3000 human-merge line). No governed path: the ADR-0076 OQ#9 line was split off into #23570, as the claim authorised.

On this head at this read: 28 success, 6 skipped, and Test Core 1–6/6 in progress. `Lint & Repo Gates` and `TypeScript Type Check` are both `success`. ⛔ No landing act until every check reads success or an expected skip.
4. **Accepted deviations.**

The claim line has no per-op edit tool, so the claim, the body and the changeset stay consistent on `no`.
5. **Out of scope, routed.**
   - Filed: #23573. A production `objectstack serve` with no storage registers no driver in silence and names no remedy (the dev's class-a finding).

Stale prose still names the retired routes: `serve.ts` step 3b's comment, `packages/client/src/index.ts`'s `getTranslations` docblock, `packages/client/src/i18n-wire-dialect.test.ts`'s `registerI18nRoutes` mention, the two route-ledger headers, `openapi-builtin-paths.ts`, `check-route-envelope.mjs`'s MODULES row, and `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/{api-backend,i18n}.json`.    - #23174's thread is told that its plugin-arm conversion is deleted with the arms (triage `6157669906` step 2).
